title: Follow-up runs itself daily, committed by the sweeper, linked from the handover

chat.text: The computed follow-up list (what was not landed, not merged, or left without an outcome) now runs on Servex's own daily tick instead of waiting for a mastermind to remember it, its two files are committed by the log sweeper, the handover links it, and the flagged count shows in the Inbox once a day.
